title: Silicon Valley's AI startups join the race for India's top tech talent
summary: Silicon Valley AI startups aggressively hire top tech talent in India, tracking 24 firms
detailed: A cohort of 24 overseas AI and new-age tech companies, tracked for ET by staffing firm Xpheno, employs around 24,000 people in India; their combined workforce has grown more than 30% over the past year, according to the firm.
